properties.statement:
Measured: Anthony attached the work field log (docs/feedback/ on the work machine, git-ignored, append-only), and its last entry is 2026-10-13. The field ask of 2026-10-19 ("in a hub, reflow2 should allow you to view all key:value pairs for each design as sort of one design") appears only as idea 20 in docs/using-reflow2-in-vscode-without-mcp.md, commit 7a47bf1f0 on feat/vscode-call-door, Assisted-by copilot:claude-opus-4-8.
The field log's own header says: append every observation there, and keep the public guide as the redacted summary. The guide's own idea table is where the agent wrote instead.
Triaged the same day:
- idea 20 → reflow2:dec:idea-a-hub-on-one-machine-opens-as-one-view-through-the-door;
- the 2026-10-13 log entry ("update recreated a removed kit in 11 member repos", also the guide's limitation 21, "not yet recorded in reflow2's design") → a root-cause in progress.
At registration (2026-10-05) the log held 334 lines; it now holds 624, so entries of 10-05 to 10-13 were added after it was registered. Whether all were triaged is not established here.
No cause is stated for why the agent chose the guide. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
